parameter_semantics: source_object selects observed blue_pose and destination_field selects calibrated blue_goal. Both enter causal relational features and the phase target; neither provides future state, code or actuator commands.
output_semantics: Each slot is a target transform from that slot's freshly measured pre-action TCP: local TCP-frame translation in metres (3), local rotation vector in radians (3), and demonstrated gripper scalar (1). Training uses each slot's action_observation TCP; execution composes each represented executed slot with the fresh current TCP supplied to decode_action. Slots represent t-1..t+14 and slots 1..8 execute at t..t+7. The resulting world target is passed to panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh measured joints.

conversion_check.description: For each label, inverse(current measured TCP) times demonstrated commanded TCP is re-composed with that same current TCP, then checked by decoded FK in position, rotation and gripper. Nonunique IK joints are allowed.

cut_relation: All twelve assigned [600,stop) ranges are supervised. The complete [600,850) overlap with red_transfer remains action-labeled, including red release, retreat, transit, blue approach, closure and lift; the auxiliary phase does not alter the cut or success definition.
